shellRecipe:
git init -q source
git -C source fetch -q --depth=1 \
  https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux.git \
  9fdd083a8181a827889337b63cd4e6daea661a8c
git -C source checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python ./source

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
.venv/bin/python quickstart.py

bundle config set --local path vendor/bundle
bundle install --jobs 2

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
bundle exec ruby quickstart.rb

git init -q source
git -C source fetch -q --depth=1 \
  https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-lua.git \
  0395620d362ef75c74cd488f9577afda68922586
git -C source checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
luarocks --tree .rocks install luv 1.52.1-0
(cd source && luarocks --tree ../.rocks make \
  rockspecs/libtmux-scm-1.rockspec)

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
eval "$(luarocks --tree .rocks path)"
lua quickstart.lua

git init -q source
git -C source fetch -q --depth=1 \
  https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-ts.git \
  46cccfef2a546de55ce8b308249b8c76339089a0
git -C source checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
bun install

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
bun run quickstart.ts
cargo build --locked --jobs 2

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
cargo run --quiet --locked

go mod tidy
go build -p 2 -o quickstart quickstart.go

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
./quickstart

# Save the files above at their displayed relative paths.
git clone https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-java.git libtmux-source
git -C libtmux-source checkout --detach 5c181887918351119bfdb3a046719fa792048e59
./libtmux-source/gradlew --project-dir . --console=plain --no-daemon --max-workers=2 \
  installDist -PexampleMain=Main
SHELL=/bin/sh build/install/api-example/bin/api-example

# Save the files above at their displayed relative paths.
git clone https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-java.git libtmux-source
git -C libtmux-source checkout --detach 5c181887918351119bfdb3a046719fa792048e59
./libtmux-source/gradlew --project-dir . --console=plain --no-daemon --max-workers=2 \
  installDist -PexampleMain=MainKt
SHELL=/bin/sh build/install/api-example/bin/api-example

# Save the files above at their displayed relative paths.
git clone https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-java.git libtmux-source
git -C libtmux-source checkout --detach 5c181887918351119bfdb3a046719fa792048e59
./libtmux-source/gradlew --project-dir . --console=plain --no-daemon --max-workers=2 \
  installDist -PexampleMain=Main
SHELL=/bin/sh build/install/api-example/bin/api-example

# Save the files above at their displayed relative paths.
cd app
dotnet restore Example.csproj
dotnet build Example.csproj -c Release --no-restore --warnaserror
export TMUX_TMPDIR=/tmp/libtmux-dotnet-dev
mkdir -p "$TMUX_TMPDIR"
unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
dotnet bin/Release/net8.0/Example.dll
dotnet bin/Release/net10.0/Example.dll

# Save the files above at their displayed relative paths.
cd app
dotnet restore Example.fsproj
dotnet build Example.fsproj -c Release --no-restore --warnaserror
export TMUX_TMPDIR=/tmp/libtmux-dotnet-dev
mkdir -p "$TMUX_TMPDIR"
unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
dotnet bin/Release/net8.0/Example.dll
dotnet bin/Release/net10.0/Example.dll

# Save the files above at their displayed relative paths.
git clone https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-cxx.git libtmux-source
git -C libtmux-source checkout --detach 3f93b021cb51e8349bfb9cecc6fd4091f6e79a0f
cmake -S libtmux-source -B library \
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="$PWD/libtmux-source/cmake/toolchains/clang-libcxx.cmake" \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DLIBTMUX_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DLIBTMUX_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
  -DLIBTMUX_BUILD_TESTING_LIBRARY=OFF -DLIBTMUX_CXX_STANDARD=23 \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++
cmake --build library -j 2
cmake --install library --prefix "$PWD/prefix"
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$PWD/prefix" -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-stdlib=libc++ -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=23
cmake --build build -j 2
build/api_example

# Save the files above at their displayed relative paths.
git clone https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-swift.git libtmux-source
git -C libtmux-source checkout --detach 7993e7044347629b08020e9b02ae8bcffa0e5898
swift build --jobs 2 --product ApiExample
.build/debug/ApiExample

pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '
  $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
  $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path ./modules -Force
  Save-PSResource -Name LibTmux -Version 0.1.0 `
    -Path ./modules -TrustRepository
'

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File quickstart.ps1

git init -q source
git -C source fetch -q --depth=1 \
  https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-julia.git \
  6f62bd72cb8d99f3759ca5e2cc3591165a03c768
git -C source checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
julia --startup-file=no --project=source quickstart.jl

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
elixir quickstart.exs
